stones.label: Indispensable Gray Stone Metropolis
stones.calvino_detail: Big Fedora of heavy gray stone, unceasingly mutating across 12 urban parcels into what is accepted as necessary when it is not yet so.

stones.label: Central Metal Building (Fedora's Museum)
stones.calvino_detail: At the center of Fedora stands that metal building with a crystal globe in every room, expanding by a room with each superseded future.

stones.label: Refractive Azure Crystal Globes
stones.calvino_detail: Looking into each crystal globe, one sees a miniature blue city, the model of a different Fedora rendered a toy in a glass globe by urban mutation.

stones.label: Room I — Canal Pond with Medusas
stones.calvino_detail: Miniature blue canal reservoir filled with pulsing medusas where the visitor imagines his own reflection, dried up by the Granite Freight Culvert.

stones.label: Room II — High-Canopied Elephant Avenue
stones.calvino_detail: Miniature blue boulevard with high-canopied observation boxes along the avenue reserved for elephants, banished by Low Iron-Girder Viaducts.

stones.label: Room III — Twisting Spiral Minaret Slide
stones.calvino_detail: Miniature blue helical minaret down whose spiral chute citizens slide, denied a pedestal by Squat Basalt Flue-Bastions.

stones.label: While-Building Obsolescence & Crystallization
stones.calvino_detail: As the visitor sculpts a live miniature blue model for current Fedora, gray-stone Fedora mutates past it, sealing the possible future into a new crystal globe.

stones.label: Equal Place on the Great Khan's Atlas
stones.calvino_detail: Both the big stone Fedora (accepted as necessary when not yet so) and the little Fedoras in glass globes (imagined as possible and a moment later possible no longer) hold equal claim as assumptions.

inner_arch.thesis: Asymmetric temporal obsolescence balanced by ontological parity: gray stone necessity perpetually invalidates blue crystal possibility in time, yet both are pure assumptions claiming equal room on Kublai Khan's Atlas.
inner_arch.causal_invariant: Mutating any parcel or advancing gray-stone Fedora's epoch while a miniature blue model is under conception irrevocably seals that blue model into a numbered museum room (`status: possible_no_longer`) and increments `centralMetalBuilding.roomCount`.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Split architectural cast-iron museum & refractive cobalt lens instrument pairing an oblique gray-granite urban mutation canvas (`FedoraStoneNecessity`) with a spherical-caustic crystal globe gallery & live blue counterfactual workbench (`FedoraCrystalGlobes`) plus resonant granite/iron/glass-harmonic WebAudio.

hard_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone `index.html`: zero `http://` or `https://` URLs, zero `../` imports, zero `fetch()`, clean `node --check` syntax, zero runtime errors, clean non-overlapping layout at `1280x800` desktop and `390x844` mobile, `prefers-reduced-motion` honored, gesture-safe muteable WebAudio (`[A]`).
hard_gates.HG-2: Anti-Trude DOM morphology (`J_dom < 0.35`): bespoke custom hyphenated elements (`<fedora-metal-museum>`, `<stone-metropolis-frame>`, `<crystal-globe-gallery>`, `<azure-counterfactual>`, `<obsolescence-clock>`, `<fedora-plate-drawer>`) and Fedora-scoped CSS classes with zero generic boilerplate selectors.
hard_gates.HG-3: Blind title-masked recognition of Cities & Desire 4 + full causal enactment of all 8 stones: gray stone metropolis across 12 parcels, central metal museum, Rooms I–III (medusa canal pond with reflection, high-canopied elephant avenue, twisting spiral minaret slide), live user-sculpted blue Fedora crystallizing into Room IV+ (`possible_no_longer`) upon stone mutation, and Great Khan's Atlas parity.
hard_gates.HG-4: Inspectable `<fedora-plate-drawer>` (`[P]` toggle, `[Z]` loupe, `[Escape]` close, Diptych/Map/Image tabs preferring `src="map.png"` with `map.svg` fallback and `src="image.png"`, `[hidden] { display: none !important; }`) + verified valid `map.png` (`1600x1200`) and `image.png` (`1600x1000`) on disk.
